chunks: As for the time of his emergence, the Imam (peace be upon him), it is not known to us in detail; rather, he is hidden from us until Allah grants permission for the relief (reappearance).
ai.seo_question: When will the Imam of the Age reappear?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi highlights that while the Imam's emergence is certain, its precise timing remains divinely concealed from the general public, reinforcing the concept of *al-Ghaybah al-Kubra* as a period of waiting (*intizar*) rather than passive ignorance. This uncertainty serves as a test of faith, urging believers to remain spiritually prepared until Allah decrees the time for the global establishment of justice.
